verdict.rationale: Docusign's core eSignature product supports the underlying mechanics needed for board consents/resolutions — reusable templates, configurable workflows, delegated signing, and multi-party approval routing (docusign-docs-4,6,7,9,21) — which legal-ops could adapt to circulate and collect signatures on board resolutions. However, there is no evidence of a purpose-built 'board consent' or 'corporate resolution' template, governance-specific approval chain, or minute-book/record-keeping feature tailored to equity-fundraising board actions. Missing for 10: named board-resolution/consent templates, governance-specific multi-signer sequencing, and any customer proof of using Docusign specifically for board approvals in a fundraising context.
